# Vendored glass-midas

Unmodified copies of the published npm packages (MIT), so the UI works offline:

- @glass-midas/core 0.3.0 -> core/
- @glass-midas/components 0.7.0 -> components/

Only dist .js/.css and LICENSE are kept (no .d.ts / source maps).
Update by re-running `npm pack` for a pinned version and copying dist again.
New components are requested in docs/glass-midas-component-requests.md, never edited here.
